newsitem.title: UK: Merrydown says H1 sales up on previous year.
newsitem.headline: Merrydown says H1 sales up on previous year.

text.p: UK drinks manufacturer and distributor Merrydown Plc said on Monday that sales revenues for the six months to September 30, 1996 would be ahead of the same period last year but warned profitability would be slightly hit by advertisting costs for the "Two Dogs" brand.
"Merrydown continues to focus on growing profitable sales of its brands, and maintaining tight controls on all areas of cost.
Subject to unforeseen circumstances the board is confident of a satisfactory outcome for the year as a whole," Merrydown's chairman Richard Purdey told the group's annual meeting.

Purdey said Merrydown's exclusive UK and European manufacturing and distribution rights for Two Dogs had put it in "a unique position as a cider company to be a profitable player in the fast growing alcoholic soft drinks market."

While intense competition in this sector had slowed Two Dogs' volume compared to its launch a year ago, substantial investment in advertising the brand in the UK and progress in establishing distribution in several European Union countries should pay dividends for the brand's long-term success, he said.
